page.title: World Backups
page.description: Create, restore, and manage your server world backups

remoteDisabled.title: Backups disabled for remote servers
remoteDisabled.description: The active server is configured as remote, so the panel can't reach its filesystem. Create, upload, and restore are unavailable until you switch to a local server.

alerts.noLocalFile: This backup has no local file on record — restore/download are unavailable.

errors.checksumOrIntegrity: Checksum or archive integrity check failed.
errors.failedBuildAuthUrl: Failed to build the auth URL
errors.noActiveSave: No active save is configured, so there is nothing to preview.

backup.title: Backup Settings
backup.frequencyDescription: How often the panel automatically creates a backup of your world save.
backup.frequencyContext: More frequent backups mean less data loss if the server crashes or a save gets corrupted, but each run uses CPU and disk I/O while it copies the world.
backup.maxBackupsDescription: Number of automatic backups kept before the oldest one is deleted.
backup.maxBackupsContext: Set this based on available disk space and world save size — once you're over the limit, the oldest backup is removed each time a new one is created.
backup.scheduleDescription: How often to automatically create backups
backup.keepDescription: Oldest backups will be auto-deleted when limit is reached

backupHeader.formatDescription: Compression format used for manually created backups.
backupHeader.formatContext: .zip is the most compatible everywhere. .tar.gz and .tar.zst produce smaller files but need standard Linux tools (tar) to extract.
backupHeader.destination: Choose where to save the backup
backupHeader.uploadHint: Upload an existing world_backup_*.zip from another machine
backupHeader.remoteDisabled: Backups are not available for remote servers

statusCards.autoBackupDescription: Enables the scheduled backup job configured in Backup Settings.
statusCards.autoBackupContext: When off, backups only happen when you click Create Backup manually — turn this on if you want protection without remembering to do it yourself.

advanced.noDestinationsDescription: Backups only go to the local backups folder until you add another destination.

destination.title: Add Backup Destination
destination.description: Configure where backups get copied after they're created.
destination.name: Name
destination.folderIdPlaceholder: Leave blank to upload to Drive root
destination.googleDriveInfo: Add the destination, then use the "Connect" flow on its card below to link a Google account via OAuth.
destination.notImplementedWarning: {{type}} support is coming soon. You can save this configuration now — it will activate once support ships, but Test/Save-to-destination won't work yet.
destination.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Backups already copied there are not removed.

googleDrive.clientSecretPlaceholder: Client secret from Google Cloud Console
googleDrive.redirectUriHint: Must match a redirect URI registered for this Client ID in Google Cloud Console.
googleDrive.authCodePlaceholder: Paste the code Google gave you
googleDrive.clientIdDescription: Enter the OAuth Client ID from Google Cloud Console.
googleDrive.missingInfoDescription: Enter the Client Secret and paste the authorization code Google gave you.

compaction.title: Save Compaction
compaction.description: Removes stale save chunk data older than a cutoff to reclaim disk space.
compaction.backupCreated: A safety backup was created first.
compaction.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes stale chunk data older than {{days}} day{{plural}} ({{size}} across {{chunks}} chunks). A safety backup will be created first, but this action cannot be undone otherwise.

formatComparison.title: Format Comparison
formatComparison.description: Compresses a real sample of your save with each format and compares size vs. speed.
formatComparison.noData: Run a comparison to see size and speed for each available format.
formatComparison.formats: {{count}} format{{plural}} available: {{formats}}. Run a comparison to see real numbers for your save.
formatComparison.unavailableDescription: No save is configured to sample from yet.

history.title: Backup History
history.description: New-format backups tracked with checksums, destinations, and a server config snapshot.
history.noRecordsDescription: Backups created with the enhanced format (checksums, verification, destinations) will show up here.

detail.title: Backup Details
detail.loadFailed: Could not load this backup record.
detail.modsEmpty: No mods tracked at backup time.

fileList.title: Backup Files
fileList.noBackupsDescription: Create a backup before changing saves, mods, or server settings — one bad update away from lost progress.

restore.title: Restore Backup
restore.description: Restore {{backupName}}. This will replace the current world data.

bullets.backup: The panel will create a safety backup before restoring.

delete.title: Delete Backup
delete.single: Delete {{name}}? This permanently removes the backup file.
delete.multiple: Delete {{count}} backups? This permanently removes those files.

deleteOlder.title: Delete Old Backups
deleteOlder.description: Delete every backup older than the number of days you choose here.
deleteOlder.label: Delete backups older than
deleteOlder.warning: This permanently deletes backups created more than {{days}} days ago.
